description: Sixteen pads that pick a cell on a Bene, and goes immediately to the right of it

params.text: Holding this pad moves the Bene's cursor to the matching cell of its grid and holds the Bene's gate output high

notes: the pads do nothing unless a Bene is the module immediately to the left; BenePads has no jacks of its own and reaches the Bene only through that connection
